title: From Code to Playable Systems: CEGame-Bench for Long-Horizon Game Creation Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.26098v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A game ships when a player can launch it, finish it, and return to a saved world, none of which a successful build guarantees, yet game-creation agents are mostly tested on one engine or on one-prompt browser games. We present CEGame-Bench, the first long-horizon benchmark for complete-game creation across five production engines: Defold, Godot, Roblox Studio, Unity, and Unreal Engine. Agents build each game from an empty project and a design document in runs averaging up to 295 steps and 65M tokens; the document doubles as a contract, and a hidden evaluator accepts a game only by real-input play. Under four scaffolds, agents earn most integration points but usually under half the gameplay points, and their games reach the ending in only 16% of runs, while references built by engineers with coding agents score near the maximum, which places this artifact-to-play gap in the agents. translated_title: 从代码到可玩系统：面向长程游戏创作智能体的CEGame-Bench
translated_abstract: 一款游戏只有在玩家能够启动它、通关它并回到已存档的世界时才算真正交付，而一次成功的构建并不能保证这些；然而，游戏创作智能体大多只在单一引擎或单提示词的浏览器小游戏上进行测试。我们提出CEGame-Bench，这是首个跨五个生产级引擎（Defold、Godot、Roblox Studio、Unity和虚幻引擎）的完整游戏创作长程基准。智能体从空项目和一份设计文档出发构建每个游戏，单次运行平均多达295步、消耗6500万token；设计文档同时充当契约，而一个隐藏的评估器只通过真实输入试玩来接受一款游戏。在四种脚手架框架下，智能体虽能获得大部分集成分数，但游戏性分数通常不到一半，且其游戏仅有16%的运行能到达结局；相比之下，由工程师借助编码智能体构建的参考游戏得分接近满分，从而将这种“产物到可玩”的差距定位于智能体本身。此外，没有哪两个引擎对配置的排名是一致的（Kendall's τ……（原文摘要在此处截断））。
tldr: 该论文提出首个跨五个生产级游戏引擎的完整游戏创作长程基准CEGame-Bench，通过真实输入试玩的隐藏评估发现：智能体虽能完成构建与集成，但其作品仅16%能真正通关，而工程师参考作品接近满分，从而揭示“产物到可玩”的差距主要存在于智能体本身。
en_tdlr: CEGame-Bench is the first long-horizon benchmark for complete-game creation across five production engines, where real-input play evaluation reveals that although agents handle building and integration well, only 16% of their games are playable through to the ending—localizing the artifact-to-play gap in the agents themselves.
